column1: # Baba Is You: Hempuli Oy, Chowdren (Clickteam Fusion compiled to C++) with the game's Lua scripts, SDK 13.3.2, NVN; update 1.0.10 (v655360).
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py) on Linux and checked on an iPhone 16 Pro: it needed no change, boots to its title and plays at 60 fps (470 MB)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# a grid game that moves one step per press (its own controls map movement to the D-pad as well as the stick): the D-pad layout
# load order as on Horizon: main, sdk. Assets.dat holds the pictures and sounds; Data/ the Lua scripts and the levels (Data/Worlds/*/*.ld)
# Saves (the save mount, save:/): ba.ba (global), <slot>ba.ba (slot n+1's progress: Data/Editor/editor_menudata.lua), Settings.txt and levels/ (the editor's). The INI files are the PC
# version's, so a PC save (%APPDATA%\Baba_Is_You\0ba.ba and ba.ba, not its SettingsC.txt) copied into the app's Documents/save/ with the game closed carries over
# no virtual address memory (the NPDM declares no system resource); main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region in a 4 GB block. The rewritten modules
# with main's 71 MB bss are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory
# 224 shaders: GLSLC outputs of several stages in the RomFS (shader_split.py, e98a115)
